claim: P(IK) trained on TriviaQA generalizes in discrimination to Python function synthesis and other OOD tasks but is poorly calibrated there.
stance_target: early evidence that model-internal self-knowledge extends to code, with miscalibration
quoted_support: we also find some generalization across tasks, for example from trivia to story completion, math, and code

breadth.confidence_families: P(True) self-evaluation and P(IK) trained value-head classifier on the model itself (Sec 4-5)
breadth.base_vs_instruct: pretrained models vs RLHF policies (Sec 3.3 'RLHF Policy Miscalibration Can Be Remediated with a Temperature Tuning')
breadth.elicitation_formats: multiple-choice letter probabilities, P(True) on sampled answers, P(IK)
breadth.benchmarks: TriviaQA, Lambada, Arithmetic, GSM8k, Codex HumanEval, Python function synthesis (Fig 1, Fig 2)
breadth.calibration_metrics: calibration plots, ECE-style, accuracy improvement conditioned on P(True) > 0.5 (Fig 1)
